notes: P22b3ba7c9c G4. Printed: '... you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Ajani, Inspiring Leader, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.' Two Ajanis in seat 0's library, one in its graveyard. Seat 0 takes the may and searches only its library (option 1), picking the first library copy: exactly that one goes to its hand; the other library copy stays in the (shuffled, '*') library and the graveyard copy stays in the graveyard.
